title: Corruption Pool
description: A pool of liquid corruption bubbles silently in a depression where the ground has given way to something deeper. Its surface is a mirror that reflects nothing — or perhaps reflects what lies beneath everything. The stone around its edges has crystallized into jagged formations, warped by prolonged exposure.

choices.label: Skim the corruption
choices.description: Carefully draw samples of the living corruption into sealed containers.

choices.label: Harvest the crystallized edges
choices.description: Break off the entropy-saturated crystal formations ringing the pool.

choices.label: Search the warped debris
choices.description: Pick through the distorted remains of objects half-consumed by the corruption.

choices.label: Leave it undisturbed
choices.description: The pool seems to watch you. Better not to linger.
